images.title: An *AI Receptionist* for physio and wellness clinics
images.sub: Plans of care, insurer paperwork, no-shows and after-hours calls, and what stays with the practitioners.

images.name: duties
images.title: The clinic front desk, *duty by duty*
rows: Books the visits a practitioner sets and follows up with patients who have visits left and nothing booked.
Sends reminders, moves appointments and fills freed-up times from the short-notice list.
Asks the clinic's intake questions and books the right visit type with the right practitioner.
Collects claim numbers and referrals, tracks approved visits and flags what's missing.
Gathers the details, then passes them to whoever does billing.
Gives the clinic's written instructions and alerts the practitioner on duty.

images.name: day-on-shift
images.title: A day at a *physiotherapy clinic*
rows: A patient cancels by text. It offers the 8 am slot to the short-notice list and fills it.
Checks today's files. Two auto insurance patients are missing claim numbers, so it texts both.
Plan-of-care check: four patients have visits left and nothing booked. It sends each one open times.
A caller hurt their knee yesterday and has swelling. It gives the written instructions and alerts the physio.
A patient asks whether to keep doing an exercise that hurts. It books a call back with their physio.
Sends tomorrow's reminders and moves two appointments when patients reply.
A patient says their extended health claim was denied. It collects the details for billing.
Answers an after-hours call and books a massage therapy appointment for Saturday.

images.title: How an AI Receptionist *is set up* at a clinic
steps: A business associate agreement in the US, or your country's equivalent, before any patient data.
Visit types, lengths and assessment slots for each practitioner.
What each insurer or plan needs before a visit, and who handles disputes.
Schedule, contacts, visit types and insurer fields. No treatment notes.
It drafts while the clinic manager reads the log, then takes on more.
Update it when practitioners, hours or insurer forms change.
